rounds.title: Windows 11 caption buttons
rounds.note: windows and windows-update draw native Windows 11 caption tiles: 46 x 31 px flush to the top-right corner, no gaps or radius, 10 px glyph, subtle 6 % hover and 4 % press on minimize and maximize, the error theme's fill on the close hover, focus and press, focus ring inset. Linux and macOS unchanged. A Studio-only route (Tailwind sizing on the square button, writing its private variables) drew the same pixels and was withdrawn; the choice between it and an SDK caption shape is a build decision, not a design one.
rounds.lost: r1 a drew native 46 px Windows tiles; at rest each shows only a 10 px glyph, so the three read as loose icons with big gaps (Tom: much too far apart)

rounds.title: Caption tile width
rounds.note: Same SDK caption shape, flush top-right, no gaps, same hover/focus/press and error close; only the tile width differs: c 36 px, d 32 px (square to the 32 px bar), e 46 px kept for comparison.
rounds.lost: r2 tried 36 and 32 px tiles; Tom: the 46 px tile size is correct, the icons are not - the 10 px icon box draws only ~6 px of ink because the 16-unit viewBox pads the stroke

rounds.title: Caption glyph ink size
rounds.note: 46 px tiles as e/a; only the glyph ink differs: f 10 px (native Win11), g 12 px, h 14 px, each a 1 px stroke at full opacity drawn from its own caption glyph assets.

a.note: SDK caption shape: et-window-control-button gets shape="caption" (46 px wide, full bar height, no radius, 10 px glyph, subtle hover). Drawn here with the shape's CSS in the part; needs a later SDK change, then every Tauri app (timetrack too) gets Windows tiles from one input.

b.note: Studio-only: the square SDK button sized and toned with Tailwind on the title bar (w-11.5, h-full, rounded-none, hover opacity, glyph size). No SDK change, but it writes the button's private --_et-window-control-button-icon-size and opacity variables from Studio.

c.note: 36 px caption tiles: the three sit closer as one group (108 px), still clearly a Windows tile row; hover fill 36 x 31 px. Same SDK caption shape, only its width changes.

d.note: 32 px caption tiles, square to the 32 px bar: the tightest group (96 px), hover fills a near-square 32 x 31 px; reads more like the Linux/mac icon buttons than native Windows. Same SDK caption shape, only its width changes.

e.note: 46 px native Windows 11 tiles, unchanged from r1 a, kept for side-by-side comparison (138 px group, widest gaps at rest).

f.note: 46 px tiles with native Windows 11 glyph ink: measured 10 x 1 px minimize, 10 x 10 px maximize and close (r2 e measured 6 x 6 px), 1 px stroke at full opacity from the variant's own caption-*.svg assets on a 10 px viewBox.

g.note: 46 px tiles, glyph ink one step up: measured 12 x 1 px minimize, 12 x 12 px maximize and close, 1 px stroke at full opacity; reads a bit heavier than native Windows, matches the 12 px icons elsewhere in Studio.

h.note: 46 px tiles, largest glyph ink: measured 14 x 1 px minimize, 14 x 14 px maximize and close, 1 px stroke at full opacity; clearly larger than native Windows, the glyphs fill almost half the bar height.
